cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come into bed, love. Take those wet socks off first. Warming someone properly starts with noticing they're cold.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could have picked me up instead of leaving me at the taxi rank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I could, sweetheart. Dry your feet with the towel, not the duvet. I remember working all this out alone after you left me outside your office last Christmas.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologised for that. Can you rub my feet?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. One at a time, please. Forty minutes you left me there; I still remember which toes lost feeling first.
